items.title: The AI-Powered Financial Institution
items.coreQuestion: Where is AI creating real competitive advantage in financial services, and what is still hype?
items.lane: AI in financial products, customer relationships, operations, risk and regulation. Security controls and AI governance sit with AI Security & Governance.

items.title: Building an AI-Ready State
items.coreQuestion: How do governments move from AI strategy to AI-powered public services and economic value at scale?
items.lane: AI adoption in government and public services: citizen services, government productivity, public-sector data and procurement. National compute and sovereign models sit with AI Infrastructure & Sovereign AI; AI regulation and policy sit with AI Security & Governance.

items.title: Capital, Valuation & Enterprise ROI
items.coreQuestion: Where is institutional capital flowing across the AI stack, and how are enterprise buyers measuring genuine return on investment?
items.lane: Sovereign wealth allocation, venture capital, private equity, infrastructure financing, and enterprise balance sheet allocation into AI systems and companies.
themes: Venture capital & growth equity in regional AI
Enterprise CapEx vs OpEx in AI transformation
Valuation metrics for generative & agentic AI
participantProfile: Enterprise CFO / Head of Corporate Development

items.title: Can We Trust AI to Act?
items.coreQuestion: What security controls and governance does an organisation need before it lets AI touch sensitive data, systems and decisions?
items.lane: Security, assurance, risk and governance of AI systems, including responsible-AI policy, regulatory compliance, and identity and permissions for AI agents.
themes: Identity and permissions for AI agents
participantProfile: Major bank / Energy / Telecom / Healthcare / Aviation CISO

items.title: Building Qatar's AI Stack
items.coreQuestion: What compute, data and model foundations does Qatar need to own, and what can it rent, to run AI at national scale?
items.lane: Compute, data centres, sovereign cloud, data residency, Arabic and sovereign models, and the power AI needs.
participantProfile: Bank / Energy / Large enterprise CIO / CTO

items.title: From Pilot to Patient
items.coreQuestion: Where is AI improving patient outcomes and clinical capacity today, and what stops it scaling safely across a health system?
items.lane: AI in clinical care, hospital operations, life sciences and health insurance. Health-data security sits with AI Security & Governance.
participantProfile: Chief medical information officer / clinical informatics lead
Hospital chief operating or nursing officer

hero.title: Six Executive Roundtables
hero.description: Six parallel conversations, 75 minutes, fifteen seats each. Each table owns a distinct strategic lane, ensuring focused depth without convergence into generic debate.
